notes.title: [GAMER Plan] Fantasy 2D side scrolling combat game "ReTAKE" will be released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/be9103e0bbb19827dd759c6e0073fa4045f31756.png[/img]

[GAMER Plan]"ReTAKE" will be released!
GAMER Plan is a new brand that will focus on releasing interesting and fun all-ages games!

"ReTAKE" is the latest fantasy 2D side scrolling combat game! Upgrade your favorite characters, collect rare items that allow you to unlock special skills and spells, get monsters as pets, and join your friends to defeat the hordes of enemies and numerous giant bosses!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940360/ReTAKE/

Please don't forget to follow us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/gamerplan]our Steam Publisher page[/url] to get the latest information!

notes.title: Oyabu Clinic Deathcare Corporation will be released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42263854/1debb73c3f09be573780a689e33244d983e6584b.png[/img]

Oyabu Clinic Deathcare Corporation developed by Flying Panjandrum will be released by GAMER Plan!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2227450/_/

This game is not about healing patients. It's an SLG game where you play as a quack doctor who kills patients and extorts money from them.
